compatibility_window.additive_phase: 20260810143000 supplies explicit activation and records no state-read proof
compatibility_window.enforcement_phase: 20260810150000 routes both canonical and legacy completion through one server-authenticated transaction
compatibility_window.closure_phase: 20260810160000 removes direct DML and legacy-writer authority, fences terminal conflicts, and writes manager outbox evidence
compatibility_window.operational_closure_phase: 20260810170000 recovers durable exact-start proofs, retires every service-role generic writer, and runs leased reconciliation notification delivery
compatibility_window.final_operational_correction_phase: 20260810190000 fences reassigned proof replay, retires alternate terminal writers and purge, and records idempotent recipient delivery evidence

rollback.before_enforcement: legacy Engine and current backend completion remain available
rollback.after_enforcement: roll traffic only to the retained bridge backend artifact; it is capability-aware and never re-enables direct SQL writers
rollback.database: forward-only; do not down-migrate contexts, proofs, reservations, reconciliation, audit, scan evidence, dispositions, or outbox evidence

source_identity.acceptance_input_contract: The cutover invocation must supply a regular, mode-0444 JSON file outside this worktree with one exact expected_commit, expected_tree, and this exact authority_content_paths array. The executable gate derives all authority hashes from that expected Git tree; generated evidence is never its own identity authority.

phase_order: configure CUSTODIAL_BACKEND_PROOF_SECRET (minimum 32 characters) and matching database SHA-256 digest
deploy the bridge backend; it falls back only on absent authoritative procedures
require a green authority health gate and direct-DML denial probes before routing traffic

rollback.precondition: retain the exact bridge backend artifact and the execution secret until all authority health and restoration probes are green
rollback.action: roll traffic back to the bridge backend artifact; it selects the authoritative procedure when present and only uses legacy fallback when the procedure is absent
restoration_checks: exact start and completion replay return one durable proof, reconciliation, and completion
service_role direct insert/update/delete/truncate probes are denied
named-manager reconciliation read, exactly-once disposition replay, and notification retry state remain available

authority_content_identity.binding: The executable cutover gate requires externally supplied exact expected_commit and expected_tree, verifies this evidence file as a blob in that tree, then hashes every listed authority path from that tree and compares each worktree byte sequence with its exact tree blob.

manager_recovery.authority: active named manager; disposition write additionally requires DIRECTOR or SECURITY_ADMIN

release_boundary: Configure a minimum-32-character CUSTODIAL_BACKEND_PROOF_SECRET and matching database digest before Phase A, retain the bridge backend artifact through Phase C, and require the executable health/restoration probes before traffic changes.
